_comment: Robinhood Chain mainnet (chain 4663). Contracts restored from the Downloads copy.

contracts._v4Comment: Uniswap v4 on Robinhood Chain, from developers.uniswap.org deployments. Read-only: the dashboard shows v4 positions; the collector does not touch them.

v4._pricingHooksComment: Hook addresses whose v4 pools the portfolio pricer also checks (the hookless key is always tried). Launchpad hooks seen so far: Pools.trade (0xeb1E…, SEAL/ETH), 0x11aF… (Bucket/ETH), 0xE5e7… (BULLIONS/ETH, fee 0). Unknown ones are learned automatically from the token's recent swaps.

contracts._v2FactoryComment: Uniswap v2 factory on Robinhood Chain (read from NET.uniswapV2Factory). Portfolio pricing falls back to a v2 pair when no v3 pool is deep enough.

thresholds._minWethPerPosition: Skip a position unless its collectable fees are worth at least this much WETH.
thresholds._maxGasPriceGwei: Abort entirely if network gas exceeds this. Your recent range was 0.03-0.09 gwei.
thresholds._dailyGasCapEth: Hard stop once this much ETH has been spent on gas in a rolling 24h.
thresholds._slippageBps: Swap slippage tolerance in basis points. 150 = 1.5%. Thin memecoin pairs need room.
thresholds._maxSwapValueWeth: Refuse to swap more than this in one transaction. Guards against a bad quote.
thresholds._minOperatorGasBalanceEth: Warn when the operator wallet's gas float drops below this.

sweep._comment: After swapping fees to WETH: target ETH unwraps and sends ETH to sweepDestination; target USDG swaps the WETH to USDG through the WETH/USDG pool at targetFeeTier and sends that instead. Either way the operator keeps keepGasReserveEth of ETH for gas (topped up from WETH when low).

_tokenIdsComment: Leave empty to auto-discover all positions owned by ownerAddress. Or list specific IDs.
_denylistComment: Token IDs to never touch. Useful for positions you want to manage by hand.

usdReference._comment: Pool used to price WETH in USD. USDG (Global Dollar) is the native stable on Robinhood Chain; the 0.01% WETH/USDG pool is the deepest. Address read from position #834424 and verified against the factory.

dashboard._collectModeComment: What the Collect button runs: collect (fees to the owner as-is) or full (collect, convert per sweep.target, send).

swapFeeTierOverrides._comment: Force a token to swap through a specific fee tier. Required when you hold the same pair in more than one tier. Key is the token address, value is the tier in hundredths of a bip (10000 = 1%, 3000 = 0.3%, 500 = 0.05%, 100 = 0.01%).

_watchWalletsComment: Fallback only: wallets.json (owner label + watched list) is preferred when present. Entries: "0x..." or {"address": "0x...", "label": "name"}. Re-read on every refresh. Never collected from.

portfolio._priceViaComment: Tokens valued as another token 1:1: staked/wrapped receipts. sNET (StakedNET, rebasing) is redeemable 1:1 for NET via the Staking contract 0xB078cc304A0B264C5F3680DC0488954ACcd02E87.

v4Collect._comment: Uniswap v4 fee collection (collect-v4.js). Positions come from v4-positions.json (dashboard discovery) plus tokenIds here. Needs the operator approved on contracts.v4.positionManager: node approve-operator.js --v4 (owner key). Native ETH fees are wrapped to WETH above the gas reserve and swept like other fees.

staking._comment: Rebasing staking receipts to track as income (staking.js -> snet-staking.json, /api/staking, Analytics page). token = the receipt (must expose index()), underlying = what it redeems to 1:1.

_treasuryComment: LOKOVault fee split: after each wallet's fees are swapped to the sweep target, feeSplitPct % goes to treasuryTBA (the vault's token-bound account) and the rest to the wallet. treasuryTBA null = split off. feeSplitMax caps the percentage. Every split is logged to fee-split-ledger.json.

memecoinCollect._comment: memecoin-collect.js: every 15 min, when a memecoin position (config memecoins, else any v4 position in the Trading wallet) has more than minUsd of uncollected fees, run the normal collector (all wallets, vault split) instead of waiting for 09:00; at most one auto run per minIntervalMinutes.
